Navigation notes

- The Home is the canonical description of NexusG.
- Examples are illustrative only.
- reference.txt is the canonical technical reference.
- When information overlaps, prefer the Home for product behavior and reference.txt for technical definitions.

Canonical concepts

- Operational Comprehension
- Decision Domain
- Workspace
- PressureBoard
- Situation
- Evidence
- Capability
- Discovery

Current positioning

- SaaS
- Not consulting
- Built on existing enterprise systems
- Operates through MCP-compatible clients
- Does not charge per-token usage
